long_biography.plain_text:
Acciona's transformation from a family builder into an international group was the central work of Entrecanales' executive career. An industrial engineer, he served as deputy manager of Entrecanales y Távora, became vice-chairman alongside his brother, and chaired the construction business created through its merger with Cubiertas y MZOV.

Outside the boardroom, he built a collection of more than 200 contemporary works over half a century, supported younger Spanish artists and opened a Toledo exhibition space. He also founded a charitable foundation bearing his name, financing social, educational, cultural and development projects, and marked retirement with a round-the-world sailing voyage.
